entities.name: User
entities.purpose: Application identity, account status, and the existing row used to serialize a borrower’s exposure changes.
entities.checks: AccountStatus in Active/Restricted/Inactive; trimmed LoginName and DisplayName nonempty.

columns.name: UserID
columns.purpose: Stable application identity; also exposed as BorrowerID when this user owns a request.

columns.name: LoginName
columns.purpose: Case-sensitive login; no uniqueness rule on private email.

columns.name: DisplayName
columns.purpose: Account display information, not the marketplace alias.

columns.name: PublicAlias
columns.purpose: Immutable random nonidentifying marketplace alias; also binds encrypted private email before UserID allocation. Never generated from email/name.

columns.name: PrivateEmailCipher
columns.purpose: SEC-12 protected contact value.

columns.name: PasswordHash
columns.purpose: Local sample-account sign-in; never a readable password or audit value.

columns.name: AccountStatus
columns.purpose: Current account entitlement state.

columns.name: CreatedAt
columns.purpose: Account creation time.

columns.name: RowVersion
columns.purpose: Reject stale profile/account edit inputs and help validate preparation reads.

entities.notes: Administrative procedures audit account creation/status changes. UserID is never changed; no operational DELETE. The User row is locked even when no profile or loan exists, so first submissions have a stable lock target.

entities.name: Role

columns.name: RoleCode
columns.purpose: Canonical business role name.

columns.name: Description
columns.purpose: Responsibility described in FRD Section 4.

entities.notes: System operations is a technical identity, never a Role row. Role definitions are release-managed and immutable at runtime.

entities.name: UserRole
entities.purpose: Retained grant/revocation episodes with at most one active membership per pair.
entities.checks: RevokedAt and RevokedByUserID both NULL or both present; RevokedAt >= GrantedAt.

columns.name: UserRoleID
columns.purpose: Identity of one membership episode.

columns.name: UserID
columns.purpose: Member.

columns.name: RoleCode
columns.purpose: Assigned business role.

columns.name: GrantedAt
columns.purpose: Assignment time.

columns.name: GrantedByUserID
columns.purpose: Administrator; NULL only for documented initial bootstrap.

columns.name: RevokedAt
columns.purpose: Revocation time; NULL means active membership.

columns.name: RevokedByUserID
columns.purpose: Revoking Administrator.

columns.name: ActiveMarker
columns.purpose: IF(RevokedAt IS NULL,1,NULL), allowing many revoked episodes and one active episode.

entities.notes: Forbidden role combinations and removal with outstanding participation are checked while locking the target User; a new grant creates a new episode, never erases an earlier one.

entities.name: BorrowerProfile
entities.purpose: Current protected income and external monthly obligations.
entities.checks: Plaintext income > 0 and external obligations >= 0 validated before encryption; required envelopes nonempty.

columns.name: UserID
columns.purpose: Exactly one current profile per user.

columns.name: MonthlyIncomeCipher
columns.purpose: Self-reported fictional monthly income.

columns.name: ExternalObligationsCipher
columns.purpose: Monthly obligations outside the platform only.

columns.name: UpdatedAt
columns.purpose: Latest profile change.

columns.name: RowVersion
columns.purpose: Expected-version check prevents stale preparation/update.

entities.notes: No plaintext duplicate columns or searchable hashes of financial values. Profile creation requires Borrower role; current profile edits never alter RequestSnapshot.

entities.name: LoanRequest
entities.purpose: A funding request with immutable submitted terms and private input snapshot.
entities.checks: Principal between 100.00 and 2000.00; InstallmentCount in (3,6); fixed PolicyCode D1 on submission; lifecycle and snapshot-nullability rules.

columns.name: RequestID
columns.purpose: Stable request identifier.

columns.name: BorrowerID
columns.purpose: Owner; assigned from trusted session.

columns.name: Purpose
columns.purpose: Borrower-supplied request purpose.

columns.name: Principal
columns.purpose: Requested principal, frozen after submission.

columns.name: InstallmentCount
columns.purpose: Accepted repayment term.

columns.name: PolicyCode
columns.purpose: NULL before submission; fixed D1 at submission. No policy-version FK.

columns.name: RequestState
columns.purpose: Draft/Submitted/PendingReview/OpenFunding/Funded/Rejected/Cancelled/Expired.

columns.name: CreatedAt
columns.purpose: Request creation.

columns.name: SubmittedAt
columns.purpose: Snapshot time, not editable client time.

columns.name: FundingDeadlineAt
columns.purpose: Approval timestamp + 14 days; no extension after eligibility blocking.

columns.name: TerminalReason
columns.purpose: Controlled procedure supplies the reason; no financial correction.

columns.name: RowVersion
columns.purpose: Draft edit and stale-action detection.

columns.name: SubmittedIncomeCipher
columns.purpose: Frozen income, distinct from the mutable profile.

columns.name: SubmittedObligationsCipher
columns.purpose: Frozen external monthly obligations; platform burden is in each evaluation.

entities.notes: A Draft still obeys current D1 numeric/input validation; it may require a different effective policy at submission. A cancelled unsubmitted Draft may retain NULL policy/submission. A Submitted request must have exactly one RequestSnapshot and one Submission EligibilityCheck at commit, enforced by its transaction.

entities.name: RequestEvaluation
entities.purpose: One retained submission, review, or funding check; summaries and final decision facts remain attributable.
entities.checks: Submission attempt 0 only; other attempts >0; fixed two condition flags; one final Review decision per request; conditional completion/reviewer fields.

columns.name: EvaluationID
columns.purpose: Stable check ID; public AssessmentID is the Submission EvaluationID.

columns.name: RequestID
columns.purpose: Evaluated request; repeated attempts retained.

columns.name: EvaluationKind
columns.purpose: Checkpoint; never a request lifecycle state.

columns.name: AttemptNumber
columns.purpose: 0 for Submission; positive sequence per request/kind otherwise.

columns.name: EvaluatedAt
columns.purpose: Time when exposure/delinquency facts were observed.

columns.name: PlatformBurdenCipher
columns.purpose: Retained total of other live requests and outstanding-loan burdens; no per-obligation history.

columns.name: NoDelinquencyPass
columns.purpose: Frozen no-outstanding-delinquency condition at observation time.

columns.name: AffordabilityPass
columns.purpose: NULL only for an unprocessed Submission; completed check compares all retained inputs.

columns.name: CompletedAt
columns.purpose: Assessment completion time for Submission; check completion otherwise.

columns.name: Result
columns.purpose: NULL until complete; Pass iff both condition flags are 1. No independently editable score.

columns.name: AdministratorID
columns.purpose: Required on Review; NULL for Submission/Funding. Actor must have Administrator role.

columns.name: Decision
columns.purpose: Only a completed Review may record a final decision; blocked approval leaves NULL.

columns.name: Reason
columns.purpose: Human final-review explanation; failed machine conditions derive stable reason codes from flags.

columns.name: DecidedAt
columns.purpose: Final decision timestamp; approval starts funding window.

columns.name: ContextID
columns.purpose: Matches the operation/audit attempt, including a failed check.

columns.name: FinalReviewMarker
columns.purpose: 1 iff a final Review decision exists, otherwise NULL; preserves any number of blocked attempts.

entities.name: OperationReceipt
entities.purpose: Caller-scoped identity of one committed funding/repayment action and its original response.
entities.checks: ActionCode in CommitFunding/PostRepayment; Reference length 1–64; response snapshot nonempty at commit.

columns.name: OperationID
columns.purpose: Shared identity used by one financial event.

columns.name: CallerUserID
columns.purpose: Authenticated Lender or Borrower.

columns.name: OperationReference
columns.purpose: Client-generated opaque reference, unique across both action kinds for this caller.

columns.name: ActionCode
columns.purpose: Determines expected event table.

columns.name: ReceiptSnapshot
columns.purpose: Original receipt/summary for an exact retry; set once before commit.

entities.notes: No separately committed Pending receipt exists. Insert identity, create one event, then fill ReceiptSnapshot in one transaction. Event target/amount are compared through the immutable FundingCommitment or Repayment, not duplicated here. The opaque historical response is justified by exact-result replay; it is not a queryable replacement for normalized records. Runtime cannot edit it after the first fill.

entities.name: FundingCommitment
entities.purpose: One initial or additional promise, not one row per lender/request pair.
entities.checks: Amount > 0; state in Pending/Applied/Released; state/timestamp consistency.

columns.name: CommitmentID
columns.purpose: Unique contribution event.

columns.name: RequestID
columns.purpose: Request being funded.

columns.name: OperationID
columns.purpose: Lender is derived from its CallerUserID; action must be CommitFunding.

columns.name: EvaluationID
columns.purpose: Matching completed, passing Funding evaluation.

columns.name: Amount
columns.purpose: Immutable contribution amount.

columns.name: CommitmentState
columns.purpose: Pending/Applied/Released.

columns.name: CreatedAt
columns.purpose: Accepted contribution time.

columns.name: AppliedAt
columns.purpose: Activation timestamp.

columns.name: ReleasedAt
columns.purpose: Parent cancellation/expiration time.

entities.notes: LenderID is a view/API alias for OperationReceipt.CallerUserID, avoiding a duplicate dependency. Procedures validate CheckID.RequestID and action/actor. Multiple events for the same lender/request remain valid and individually auditable.

entities.name: Loan
entities.purpose: One activated obligation, with lifecycle and latest observation.
entities.checks: State Active/Repaid; completion NULL iff Active; observed condition Current/Delinquent.

columns.name: LoanID
columns.purpose: Stable loan identity.

columns.name: RequestID
columns.purpose: One loan per fully funded request.

columns.name: ActivatedAt
columns.purpose: Schedule origin.

columns.name: LoanState
columns.purpose: Active or Repaid, never Delinquent as a lifecycle state.

columns.name: CompletedAt
columns.purpose: Set exactly once by repayment trigger.

columns.name: ObservedCondition
columns.purpose: Last detected payment condition.

columns.name: LastEvaluatedAt
columns.purpose: Observation freshness; current reports calculate condition anew.

entities.notes: Borrower, principal, installment count, and policy come from LoanRequest; no duplicate loan terms or current balance columns. Every committed loan has all required installments.

entities.name: Installment
entities.purpose: One immutable scheduled obligation identified within its loan.

columns.name: LoanID
columns.purpose: Identifying parent.

columns.name: InstallmentNumber
columns.purpose: Ordinal unique only within this loan.

columns.name: DueDate
columns.purpose: UTC calendar due date.

columns.name: ScheduledPrincipal
columns.purpose: Fixed installment obligation.

entities.notes: No global InstallmentID. Paid/remaining amounts and overdue condition are derived from allocations. Parent Loan cannot be deleted; schedule rows cannot be altered after activation.

entities.name: Repayment
entities.purpose: One posted payment against exactly one loan.
entities.checks: RepaymentNumber > 0; Amount > 0; no mutable repayment status.

columns.name: LoanID
columns.purpose: Explicitly selected owned loan.

columns.name: RepaymentNumber
columns.purpose: Next local sequence allocated while Loan is locked.

columns.name: OperationID
columns.purpose: Caller is the owning Borrower; action PostRepayment.

columns.name: Amount
columns.purpose: Immutable posted amount.

columns.name: PostedAt
columns.purpose: Users cannot supply or change this time.

entities.notes: The public FRD RepaymentID is the stable composite identifier (LoanID,RepaymentNumber), rendered e.g. `501/2`. This is an identifier implementation, not a new business concept. Avoiding an additional global RepaymentID keeps allocation LoanID from becoming a redundant dependency. Receipts expose both components and the combined identifier.

entities.name: RepaymentAllocation
entities.purpose: Amount of one repayment assigned to one installment of the same loan.
entities.checks: AllocatedPrincipal > 0; total/cap checks in locked payment transaction.

columns.name: LoanID
columns.key: PK part; shared component of both FKs
columns.purpose: Makes cross-loan linking impossible through the declared keys.

columns.name: RepaymentNumber
columns.key: PK part; composite FK (LoanID,RepaymentNumber) to Repayment
columns.purpose: Paying event.

columns.name: InstallmentNumber
columns.key: PK part; composite FK (LoanID,InstallmentNumber) to Installment
columns.purpose: Receiving obligation.

columns.name: AllocatedPrincipal
columns.purpose: Depends on the full repayment/installment pair.

entities.notes: The two composite FKs enforce same-loan integrity without a trigger or repeated borrower ID. Procedure ensures positive allocations sum to the payment and do not exceed installment remainders.

entities.name: OversightNote
entities.checks: Exactly one RequestID/LoanID non-NULL; NoteText nonblank. The procedure rejects self/cross-target correction; a CHECK does not refer to auto-increment NoteID.

columns.name: NoteID
columns.purpose: Stable note.

columns.name: RequestID
columns.purpose: Request target.

columns.name: LoanID
columns.purpose: Loan target.

columns.name: AdministratorID
columns.purpose: Author.

columns.name: CreatedAt
columns.purpose: Append time.

columns.name: NoteText
columns.purpose: Internal follow-up; excluded from lender/borrower responses.

columns.name: CorrectsNoteID
columns.purpose: Earlier note on exactly the same target.

entities.notes: Same-target correction uses procedure validation because a self-FK alone does not ensure matching target. Never UPDATE an existing note.

entities.name: AuditEvent
entities.purpose: Append-only attributable event or observed failed/denied attempt.
entities.checks: Outcome Success/Denied/Failed/Interrupted; actor/service context and subject type validated by catalogue.

columns.name: AuditEventID
columns.purpose: Stable event ID; gaps after rollback are allowed.

columns.name: OccurredAt
columns.purpose: Detection/event time, not an invented commit timestamp.

columns.name: EventType
columns.purpose: Audited operation.

columns.name: Outcome
columns.purpose: Success, Denied, Failed, or observed Interrupted.

columns.name: ActorUserID
columns.purpose: Human actor; NULL for service or unauthenticated attempts.

columns.name: ActingRoleCode
columns.purpose: Verified business role; NULL where no human role exists.

columns.name: ServiceActor
columns.purpose: Automated actor such as assessment or activation.

columns.name: InitiatingUserID
columns.purpose: Human initiating an automated action when applicable.

columns.name: TechnicalAccount
columns.purpose: USER()/SESSION_USER(), not the definer returned by CURRENT_USER().

columns.name: SubjectType
columns.purpose: Business record type or Attempt.

columns.name: SubjectKey
columns.purpose: Affected key or attempted target; intentionally not a polymorphic FK.

columns.name: ContextID
columns.purpose: Groups business effects and failure observation.

columns.name: OperationID
columns.purpose: Committed funding/payment reference, when one exists.

columns.name: AttemptedOperationReference
columns.purpose: Reference for failed actions that have no committed receipt.

columns.name: ReasonCode
columns.purpose: Safe outcome explanation without raw private values.

entities.notes: Success routines validate SubjectType/SubjectKey against the actual affected record. An attempted nonexistent target must remain loggable, so this field is explicitly not represented as an invalid multi-table FK. AuditChange carries individual safe prior/new values. No operational UPDATE/DELETE on either table.

entities.name: AuditChange
entities.purpose: Normalized changed-field context for an audit event.
entities.checks: FieldName from the event-specific allowlist; redacted private fields NULL on both sides; StatusReason bounded and access-protected (§8.1).

columns.name: AuditEventID
columns.purpose: Owning event.

columns.name: FieldName
columns.purpose: Meaning of the change, e.g. RequestState or Amount.

columns.name: OldValue
columns.purpose: Old nonprivate value; NULL on creation or for sensitive fields.

columns.name: NewValue
columns.purpose: New scalar value; protected StatusReason follows §8.1; amounts/IDs remain in source records too.

entities.notes: No comma-separated ID lists or unstructured raw request bodies. Profile changes log field names only; historical private values remain in protected snapshots where required. Account-status explanations use StatusReason/NewValue (1–1000 characters), Administrator-only; Auditor receives NULL values. See §8.1.

relationships.label: granting administrator
relationships.note: NULL only for documented bootstrap; actor role is checked procedurally.

relationships.label: revoking administrator
relationships.note: Paired with RevokedAt; NULL for active episode.

relationships.label: profile owner
relationships.note: Required before submission, optional for other users.

relationships.label: borrowing owner
relationships.note: Many simultaneous requests and loans permitted; owner has Borrower role.

relationships.label: authenticated caller
relationships.note: Caller/reference unique across both funding and repayment action kinds.

relationships.label: funding target
relationships.note: Repeated lender/request pairs allowed; each event has a separate CommitmentID.

relationships.label: funding receipt
relationships.note: CommitFunding action; lender is receipt.CallerUserID. Receipt has exactly one event of one type at commit.

relationships.label: fully funded origin
relationships.note: Every loan has exactly one origin. The limit is per request, never per borrower.

relationships.label: identifying loan
relationships.note: Approved installment count required atomically at activation; FK alone does not enforce child count.

relationships.label: repayment receipt
relationships.note: PostRepayment action; caller must own loan. XOR with FundingCommitment at commit.

relationships.label: paying event
relationships.note: Positive allocations must sum exactly to posted repayment at commit.

relationships.label: receiving installment
relationships.note: Shared LoanID prevents allocations across loans. Installment cap and oldest-first order need transaction checks.

relationships.label: request target
relationships.note: Exactly one of RequestID and LoanID is non-NULL.

relationships.label: loan target
relationships.note: Exactly one of RequestID and LoanID is non-NULL.

relationships.label: note author
relationships.note: Administrator only; append-only notes.

relationships.label: corrected earlier note
relationships.note: Self-reference; routine validates earlier note on the same target.

relationships.label: human actor
relationships.note: May be NULL for a service or unauthenticated attempt.

relationships.label: verified acting role
relationships.note: NULL when no human role applies; verified entitlement is procedural.

relationships.label: initiating human
relationships.note: Distinct from the actor of an automated effect.

relationships.label: committed operation
relationships.note: Failed attempts may have no committed receipt; use ContextID and safe attempted reference.

operational_entities.name: build_admin.BuildRun
operational_entities.purpose: Separate operational evidence for one tagged build; not a lending entity.

columns.name: BuildRunID
columns.purpose: Runner-generated UUID.

columns.name: RequestedTag
columns.purpose: Requested immutable release label.

columns.name: ResolvedCommit
columns.purpose: NULL for failures before source retrieval; no fabricated commit.

columns.name: TargetSchema
columns.purpose: Intended isolated database.

columns.name: StartedAt
columns.purpose: Build start.

columns.name: FinishedAt
columns.purpose: NULL while running.

columns.name: Outcome
columns.purpose: Running/Succeeded/Failed.

columns.name: EnvironmentManifest
columns.purpose: Exact server/client/tool versions and container digest; no secrets.

operational_entities.notes: Created outside the target schema so a failed build/reset cannot erase its own evidence. File logs are authoritative fallback if build-log persistence is unavailable.

operational_entities.name: build_admin.BuildStep
operational_entities.purpose: Per-script execution evidence without repeating build metadata.

columns.name: BuildRunID
columns.purpose: Owning build.

columns.name: StepNumber
columns.purpose: Manifest order.

columns.name: ScriptPath
columns.purpose: Validated relative path; no shell interpolation.

columns.name: ScriptSHA256
columns.purpose: Identifies executed script bytes.

columns.name: StartedAt
columns.purpose: Step start.

columns.name: FinishedAt
columns.purpose: NULL while running.

columns.name: Outcome
columns.purpose: Step result.

columns.name: SafeError
columns.purpose: Failure context without passwords/tokens or private binds.
